thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on infer-gateway-us-west — 6m rolling error rate 18% (502/504/timeouts). Correlating with spikes in model-runner restarts. Investigating. monitor: https://mon.redwood/alerts/1738502468

Eric (oncall): I'm on it, acked the pager. Pausing new deploys to infer pools.

Nina (ml-eng): seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner logs: `segfault at 0x7ffb4c1e in kv_cache.c:532` — stack shows `model_runner::kv_cache::grow()` calls. Uploading truncated logs.

Matt (sre): quick plan: 1) divert traffic off us-west gateway -> fallback region 2) scale down quantized pools on us-west 3) rollback recent kvcache growth PR in canary 4) enable model fallback to smaller model to reduce memory pressure

Lia (support): Customer-42 and Customer-Delta reporting increased 502s. Customer-42 seeing ~40% failure on text.generate in prod. I've opened CS-5123 and notified affected contacts.

Eric (oncall): executing reroute: `fleetctl service route infer-gateway-us-west --shift-to=infer-gateway-eu-west --pct=30` and starting drain of pool us-west-quant.

OpsBot: reroute job started (job id rj-17385). Current shift: 30% -> 60% over next 10m.

infra-bot: noticed node `gpu-usw-22` OOM kills: `oom_kill: model_runner pid=23456 score=987`. Kernel dmesg snippet:``
dmesg | tail -n 5
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (model_runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
[ 1234.567891] Killed process 23456 (model_runner) total-vm:102400000kB, anon-rss:98000000kB
``

Nina (ml-eng): this looks like kvcache growth + a bad quantized shard. The canary that had the kvcache tune (commit d6f3a9) coincides with spike. Preparing hot revert.

Matt (sre): reverting canary now: `git revert d6f3a9 && kubectl apply -f canary-deploy.yaml` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner-canary`. Also scaling dedicated pool: `k scale deploy/model-runner --replicas=6 -n dedicated-us-west` to absorb traffic.

OpsBot: canary rollback started. Pod restarts rolling; canary reported healthy at +3m.

Eric (oncall): early signal: errors in diverted region down from 18% -> 5% for requests hitting eu-west. Can we keep ~50% shifted until stabilised?

Lia (support): Customer-42 reports errors dropping to ~8% after reroute; they're asking for ETA to full recovery.

Nina (ml-eng): confirming stacktrace: `#0 0x7f8b.. kv_cache.c:532` which is inside `reserve_prefix_space()`; we saw unbounded growth when prefix caching enabled with long conversation contexts. Disabling aggressive prefix caching on affected pools.

Matt (sre): changed config `kvcache.max_prefetch=0` for us-west namespace and restarted pods. Watching metrics.

infra-bot: memory pressure easing on nodes; oom events stopped for last 4m.

Eric (oncall): status check: canary rollback + kvcache change reduced errors to 2% in diverted traffic. Proceeding to drain remaining quant pools and shift remaining traffic back in stages. Documenting mitigation steps for handoff.

Lia (support): informed Customer-42 and Customer-Delta; both requested postmortem and impact window. Lia to create consolidated customer impact summary.

Matt (sre): creating incident checklist items: - RCA owner Nina - Postmortem draft by EOD - Playbook updates for kvcache thresholds and aggressive fallback policies - Add healthcheck for model-runner memory growth

Eric (oncall): handing off to night shift @Matt (sre). Current console link: https://console.redwood/incidents/1738502468. Severity P1 -> moving to monitoring->stabilized state. Last note before handoff: keep reroute at 30% for next 30m, do not re-enable aggressive prefix caching until validated by Nina.

Matt (sre): ack, taking over. Will follow up with RCA and action items.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigations applied, traffic reroute active, customer notifications sent.
